meta.task: 3-b-resume (A-Heron-Synth) — machine-readable porting spec for https://heronaiapp.com/ home page
sources: live fetches: heronai.webflow.shared.9f21166e0.min.css, heronaiapp.com/ HTML (inline style blocks), heronai-bp.netlify.app/main.js (deobfuscated hot-spots), unpkg lenis@1.1.5
meta.rounding: px values rounded to 2 decimals; rem kept exact
meta.note: All selectors are from the live Webflow DOM; GSAP tween tables extracted from the running global timeline.

stack.webflow: runtime (custom components: header-component, loading-wrap, home-hero-wrap, home-intro-wrap, home-problem-wrap, home-map-wrap, home-platform-wrap, home-why-wrap, home-usecase-wrap, home-cta-wrap, footer-wrap)
stack.customBundle: heronai-bp.netlify.app/main.js (obfuscated Vite bundle, contains Lenis + all site logic)

scrollEngine.architecture: window never scrolls — html/body overflow visible, .body-inner{overflow:hidden;height:100vh}, .main-inner{overflow:hidden} is the Lenis wrapper AND the ScrollTrigger scroller (scrollerProxy registered). html{overscroll-behavior:none}

lenisConfig.source: new Lenis({...}) found in main.js; unlisted options = Lenis 1.1.5 defaults verified against unpkg bundle

scrollEngine.rafWiring: gsap.ticker.add(t => lenis.raf(t * 1000)); gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0) — Lenis is driven by the GSAP ticker (no autoRaf)
scrollEngine.scrollBinding: lenis.on('scroll', e => { ScrollTrigger.update(); scrollerState update; if (Math.abs(e.velocity) > 0.1) <container class toggle>; 150ms settle timeout re-adds class })
scrollEngine.motionProbeNote: lenis-decay.json captured all-zero window scroll (probing window.scrollY while the real scroller is .main-inner) — no behavioral lerp/duration measurement; config taken from source instead

remBase.formula: html { font-size: <rate>vw } with 3 rates via media queries
remBase.derived: 1rem = 8.33px @1440, 9.92px @390, 11.11px @1920 — everything in the CSS is rem-based so the whole page scales with viewport

colors.paper: background-image var(--bg-img) (bg.svg tile, repeat) on .body/.bg-global; grid deco var(--bg-grid) 6.4rem tile on problem items

spacingAndLayoutTokens.bgBorderFrame: absolute inset 1.2rem (0.8rem @<=767); 4 edge items ~7px thick; 4 corner plus marks 1.2rem (0.8rem mobile)
spacingAndLayoutTokens.gaps: grid gap 0 (Webflow grid with explicit rows/cols); flex gaps 0.4/0.6/1.6/2.4rem scale; section inner paddings 1.6/2.4/3.2rem scale; intro content pad 6.4rem 15rem 3.2rem @1440

pageMap.pin: CSS sticky (.home-map-inner{position:sticky;top:0;height:calc(100dvh - 1.6rem)}) — NO GSAP pin anywhere on the page

scrollTriggers1440.animation: 4.28s per-char color tween #b3b3af -> #282828, stagger 0.03, per-char duration 0.5, power1.out, 127 chars

scrollTriggers1440.note: x8 duplicated triggers (parallax/wordmark drivers, 0-duration placeholder timelines)

deltas: no footer.footer x8 triggers (no footer parallax set on mobile)
why-img triggers collapse to 4 with near-identical ranges (7549-7574 -> 8569-8574)
intro title scrub identical (4.28s) but px range 420->1000
map wrap range 1303->7778 (shorter because 700dvh = 5796px at 828px viewport)

vars.init: gsap.set autoAlpha 0, yPercent 100 (inferred — from-state not in captured vars)

tweenTable.totals: totalDur = 0.8 + (n-1)*0.02 (hero title 9 lines = 0.96s; hero sub 25 lines = 1.28s; why sub 34 = 1.46s)

tweenTable.targets: .line-horizital / .line-vertical in hero title-wrap, sub-wrap, header-menu borders

vars.initScale: set by pre-tween (not captured; use 0.8 as port default)

tweenTable.items: SplitText reveals, delay 0.25 (menu items) / 0.2 (CTA + close row)

geometry1440.bg: transparent (both states — no blur, no border at top)

stateMachine.on-scroll: added when lenis scroll > 1 * header height (~56px); removed below
stateMachine.on-hide: added when scrolling DOWN and scroll > 5 * header height (~280px); class sets .header-inner{transform:translateY(-101%)} with transition transform 0.4s; removed when scrolling UP past 5x (show again); guarded by header :hover and a 100ms setTimeout debounce; .header.on-hide{pointer-events:none}

linkHover.current: w--current gets 0.6rem square dot after the label

menu390.open: clip-path inset(0 0 100%)->inset(0) 0.4s ease + lenis.stop(); borders L/R var(--size--border); item borders bottom
menu390.hamburger: 3 lines 1.5rem wide, var(--size--border) thick; on active first+last scale(0)

layers: home-hero-img-interact-wrap: horizontal + vertical cursor lines (vertical = 1px x 700px, opacity 0.2, mix-blend difference, follows mouse), plus-cross (0.2rem strokes), mono coordinates readouts (data-control x/y), interact card (brand bg #d72201 block at 0.72 alpha)
bg-border frame: 4 edge strips (1373x7px horizontals, 7x833 verticals @1440) + 4 corner plus SVGs
home-hero-img-inner: single img.img-basic.img-abs, mix-blend-mode multiply, padding 3.2rem
ruler: inset 3.2rem, dashed tick lines (line-dash), items opacity 0 -> 1 on hover (0.4s), left/right halves clip-path var(--clip-half)

deco cards item1 (25.6rem wide, bottom 26%, left 14%) and item2 (bottom 22%, left 50%): mono label + text, brand bg square 1.6rem (data-anim fade-loop 1.5s), active state expands bg to full card (top/right/height/width 0.4s)

drawOn.titleLines: mask reveal 0.8s power2.out stagger 0.02 (2 mask lines, 9 line divs)
drawOn.cursorLines: live mouse tracking (canvas + data-control x/y text)

manual.drawOrder: top 0.8s@0 / inner 0.65s@0.12 / upper-cols 0.45s@0.25 / pkg-top 0.75s@0.2 / pkg-upper 0.7s@0.4 / pkg-sides 0.9s@0.55 / pkg-center 0.4s@0.9 / lower-cols 0.4s@0.95 / db-bottom 0.45s@1.15

disjointed.drawOrder: circle 0.8s@0 / tops 0.35s@0.2 / sides 0.4s@0.35 / bottoms 0.6s@0.45 / boxes 0.35s@0.42 / center 0.4s@0.48; dash appear 0.35s ease-in @0.65 + infinite flow 1s linear

slow.drawOrder: uppers 0.6s@0 / upper-sides 0.3s@0.3 / upper-bottoms 0.45s@0.25 / center-left/right 0.45s@0.5 / center-line 0.4s@0.45 / lower-tops 0.45s@0.5 / lower-sides 0.35s@0.6 / diagonals 0.45s@0.65 / lower-center 0.425s@0.9; dash 0.5s ease @1

mapJourney.pin: section.home-map height 700dvh; .home-map-inner sticky top 0 height calc(100dvh - 1.6rem); NO ScrollTrigger pin
mapJourney.layers: 7 .home-map-main-img siblings all on grid-row 1/2 (same cell) — 6 cross-fade layers (initial opacity 0, .active -> 1) + 1 main; 2 .home-intel-inner ticker rows (574/589px wide); .home-map-intro card 28rem (bottom 3.2rem left 3.2rem, opacity 0, 5 content items cross-fade, 1 active); 3 .home-map-number-wrap markers (y 2651/2842/2925 @1440, hover/active -> number box opacity 1); right column .home-map-content-wrap width 0 -> 55.65rem (.expanded, transition width 0.4s)
mapJourney.svgAssembly: .home-map-img-svg path:nth-child(1..13) each pre-transformed off-canvas: (1) translate(-100vw,-16rem) (2) translate(100vw,-26rem) (3) translate(100vw,26rem) (4) translate(-20rem,-100dvh) (5) translate(-22rem,-100dvh) (6) translate(-100vw,28rem) (7) translate(-100vw,48rem) (8) translate(-48rem,100dvh) (9) translate(-28rem,100dvh) (10) translate(9rem,100dvh) (11) translate(42rem,100dvh) (12) translate(100vw,26rem) (13) translate(-70rem,-100dvh) — driven to 0 by JS as journey progresses; mobile swaps vw->% and -130/-121/160dvh variants + url(#path-filter)
mapJourney.uncaptured: stage boundaries/crossfade timing not sampled (journey-states.json stayed at defaults under instant scrollTo jumps — stage logic is not jump-driven)

whyIllustrations.cycle: 5s infinite CSS loops (why-cycle), staggered by --box-delay 0/0.4/0.8s per box
whyIllustrations.boxes: scale 0.001 -> 1 (12%->32% of cycle), hold to 62%, close by 70%
whyIllustrations.lines: 16 dashed brand lines (#fa3600, dasharray 4 4), visibility windows 30%-87% of cycle, dashoffset 0 -> -8 (0.8s linear infinite), delay = index * 0.03s
whyIllustrations.loadingCard: spinner 1s linear spin; dots 1.2s ease-in-out, delay = index * 0.2s; check pop at 80% scale 1.15; active border inset -0.2rem -> -0.4rem brand 0.4rem wide at 80-92%

pageTransition.mechanism: html carries --trans-percent / --mask-percent / --size--line custom props; .main{clip-path: inset(var(--mask-percent)) !important}; a hairline (driven by --size--line) sweeps the viewport center
pageTransition.videoEvidence: heron-home-to-about-1440.mp4 (13.56s): line-art of home morphs/dissolves into About page wireframe — vector-line continuity between pages, no color overlay
pageTransition.probeGap: page-transition.json sampled 4 elements for 5.5s with zero changes (wrong selectors) — timings above are from main.js deobfuscation

cursor.api: window.__canvasCursor (custom class, init only when matchMedia('(hover:hover)') presumably), mouse distance threshold (reachedThreshold) gates interactions
cursor.markers: data-cursor="hidden" on hero img-wrap and ruler items

loading.overlay: .loading{opacity:1;pointer-events:all} -> .loaded{display:none}; logo svg stroke draw via --loading-logo-dasharray (path length 1443.42); .loading-bg img opacity 0.32; progress items; after load the hero timeline plays
